protocol.start: D_s42/D_s43 fixed last120; Macro97/94 remains reference, not trained
protocol.architecture: unchanged768/4/8 encoder; original4x192,2layer4head seven-field query; both trainable, fixed scaling buffers
protocol.Q: original band-balanced seven-field SmoothL1 loss, original cached labels and masks; no S
protocol.H: mean of both raw-truth common-content losses; path centered per shared segment, price in one train delta scale, all common bars equal, original body/activity train scales and masks; 0.4path+0.2change1+0.1body+0.3activity
protocol.G: same family loss between own centered shared predictions; no whole-state match or old prediction as truth
protocol.sampling: one shared order/pair schedule per seed/epoch; uniform shift1or16 then uniform later endpoint[d+1,128]; both states independently see128 causal prepared features in255block; pair exposure not uniform128 and not the old D five-position schedule
protocol.raw_price: original verified float64 CSV close labels; never encoder/query inputs; original Q coordinate retained separately

optimizer.scheduler: constant; original D terminal lr, not a resumed Adam trajectory

protocol.runtime: context FP32, no AMP/TF32, original dropout0; train mode during training, eval during validation
protocol.selection: fixed last60 primary; epoch0 frozen D baseline; val at0/every5/60 monitor only, no best or early-stop selection
protocol.primary: content vs matched control AND own frozen D: later common shape MSE gain>=5% at shifts16/64, both seeds/cohorts and both cluster intervals; no promotion
protocol.protection: <=10% relative MSE cost vs both control and own D: original price/activity near/mid/far each8positions; physical common anchored/shape, entered/leaving, disagreement all3shifts; each body/activity field entered/leaving; decoded16/64 descriptors; parent price/activity P95 point ratios<=1.10
protocol.incremental_alignment: aligned vs content: >=10% disagreement MSE gain all3shifts, both seeds/cohorts/cluster intervals; also same>=5% physical primary gain vs control/D and<=10% protection vs content/control/D; content arm primary must pass first
protocol.acceptance_scope: limited paired historical-content candidate only; not all128-position/current-field utility or independent market/prediction acceptance; failure/insufficient ends fixed recipe without search
protocol.inference: 2000 paired month and contract_period_month draws seed20261010; >=100parents/6groups; reused research, no multiplicity-adjusted independent test; P95 descriptive
protocol.resume: atomic completed epochs only; pending uncommitted epoch stops, no repeat updates; unfinished evaluation chunks export-only; completed outputs reused
protocol.preflight: one joint forward and four gradient extractions checking Q+0.1H+0.01G; three zero-update backward timings; source signatures unchanged

recomputations.scope: CPU original CSV and saved arrays only; physical geometry/fields/descriptors/gate bootstrap independently implemented; original Q replay uses bound scoring implementation. No actual weights loaded.

decision.scope: fixed finite recipe, repeated research cohorts, eight endpoint positions; no model promotion or full F11/current-field/all128 utility acceptance

results.scope: 形状MSE为共同段各减自身均值后的误差；不是完整价格误差或还原百分比。保护失败细胞有相关性，计数不是独立发现数；区间未作多重比较校正。

conclusion: 真实内容监督有稳定的共同形状收益，但保留保护未通过；额外一致性无预定增益，固定配方收束，不晋升。

decision_impact.F03: 从诊断变为有受控干预证据；支持H的有限共同形状收益，不支持当前H/G完整平衡升级；不否定全部重叠方向。
decision_impact.F11: 原完整退出/用途未过保留；本次有限研究原型阶段交账完成，不追加训练作为交付条件。
decision_impact.repairs: V01-V12/V14已归档结论不推翻，不需要历史重跑；没有本轮新发现的运行错误。
decision_impact.V13: 无新独立数据，仍未执行；不把这次结果称独立泛化。
decision_impact.reference: Macro97/94不变，D及本轮候选不晋升。

purpose.evidence: F03真实共同内容形状主收益16/16通过，F11保护未过；按已承诺有限阶段终点归档研究原型，不把重建收益当通用用途或预测成功。
purpose.remaining: 通用价量复用、实际用途额外价值和未来收益尚未验收；不追加本配方。

architecture.evidence: 原768/4/8及原七字段query，完整滚动128，无新头；报告初始/末轮各132项因果/批量资格均通过。
architecture.remaining: 这些是真实CUDA回执，本地未加载权重；encoder和query共同更新不能唯一定位瓶颈，不证明层数不足或潜在信息完整。

training.evidence: 6组各60轮/2280更新；同种子起点、采样顺序、配对、LR与选模机会匹配；固定last60。报告梯度和核对差1.86e-8；360轮损失组合算术复核通过。
training.remaining: H/G是既定任务与尺度配方，系数不是梯度份额；训练样本仍4789父块，同更新不等同FLOPs。权重/Adam张量未随包导出。

validation.evidence: 24组八位置输出、原Q和物理/字段/历史描述复算；6208个决策bootstrap区间复算一致。content相对control有20个门槛外不利区间，88个保护未确认；相对D有41个未确认、0个双区间确认超过10%。
validation.remaining: 8位置非全128用途资格；P95为描述性点门槛；重复研究队列、相关多指标、13个月非独立最终认证。原Q复算沿绑定评分函数，独立算术不替代神经回放。

data.evidence: CPU核对921份原CSV指纹、7190个255-bar父块和19208个评价128窗口；完整train/val跨度无重叠，raw价格目标坐标最大差4.67e-6，在原容差内。
data.remaining: 没有新行情；活动沿原目标/mask而非本次全量raw活动重认证；EMA仍可包含更早因果历史，样本曝光不是独立新数据。

engineering.evidence: 安全解包188成员，172个可用绑定文件SHA一致、协议/源码指纹一致；退出0，单次12257秒，预算内，6个pt明确省略。仅更新报告复核、roadmap镜像和日志。
engineering.remaining: 权重哈希与优化器步数依赖远端回执，未重放真实模型；既有API依赖祖先目录与特征准备，不是自包含生产包。

stage_delivery.comparators: D_s42/D_s43 fixed last120 retained as research comparisons; content/aligned last60 are archived tradeoff experiments, not promoted

interface.input: prepared float32 Nx128x28 single-contract15/30/60 features with exact train normalization, causal EMA and closed endpoint identities; or Nx768 matching state_signature
interface.output: endpoint768 state; original127x7 history query; relative close path; estimated past16/64 direction/volatility summaries
interface.dependency: requires retained readability/coverage/ancestor weights and caches, not a stand-alone archive or raw/live-bar adapter
interface.observed_audit_limit: old optional observed_audit inherits cached truth; near-flat label issue is archived, use history_price_truth for correct raw-price evaluation

stage_delivery.supported: A callable causal historical-state research prototype and scoped reconstruction/descriptor recovery evidence, with known tradeoffs. Reference is not globally best.
limits: No reliable future forecast or trading performance evidence
Current age0 body/activity and full wicks not newly qualified
Physical quantity reconstruction is not implied by normalized activity fields
Flat/low-motion failure and insufficient support retained
No independent new-market-data confirmation; V13 remains open
Local and far-history protection can conflict; tail mean does not protect every field
stage_delivery.next: 阶段交账已完成，不自动追加实验；未来围绕一个具体用途及读取代价另定F11问题和同信息raw/PCA/简单特征基线，原F分支保留，V13只在数据合格时进入。
